notes: Guards who get shot now stagger back and fall to the ground, and once a medic patches them up they roll over, get back on their feet and run back to their post.

Attackers now shoot: mites spit acid and lunge, crawlers and raiders fire from a distance, and they go for your guards and drones first, then you. If you go down you drop your pack and get back up after a moment.
Guards and drones are tougher, but a downed guard bleeds out unless a medic reaches it. Drones dock in their post between waves and keep their health.
Rangers and every other helper now find their way through gates, including the protein hunter on level 17.
Scrap from fallen attackers lands where you can reach it, attackers no longer stack on top of each other, and they come in from further off screen.
Turrets, drones, guards and rangers all show their shots now.
